description: This file defines the BookingEmailAndSmsTaskService class, which handles booking-related email and SMS notifications, including request, confirmation, rescheduling, and rereshceduling logic.

classes.name: BookingEmailAndSmsTaskService
classes.description: Service class for handling booking email and SMS notifications, including request, confirmation, rescheduling, and rereshceduling.

methods.name: _getVerifiedBookingData
methods.description: Fetches and verifies booking data, builds calendar event, and returns booking, event type, and calendar event.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Handles sending a booking request notification.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles sending a booking confirmation notification.

methods.name: reschedule
methods.description: Handles sending a reschedule notification, including fetching original booking data and determining if the organizer has changed.

methods.name: rrReschedule
methods.description: Alias for reschedule method, handles rereshceduling notifications.
